# The digest of every script of the corpus.
#
# The corpus is the scripts a game ships; it is not in this repository.
# The corpus is rebuilt from the game with
# `crates/tjs/tools/extract_corpus.py`, and the check is
#
#     cargo run -p tjs --example corpus_digest -- --corpus <corpus directory>
#
# Every line is the SHA-256 of the canonical form of one compiled script
# block, and the script's path under the corpus root. The canonical form
# covers the whole block: every context's kind, name, code stream,
# constant area, counts, source positions, relations and member
# registrations, and the block's own shape.
#
# The digests were recorded from the tree's own front end, before it was
# removed. A script that front end cannot compile is listed as skipped.
